description: Oil & Gas Development Company Limited (OGDCL) is Pakistan's leading exploration and production company, maintaining a portfolio that spans both mature and frontier regions. Its core business is the exploration and production of hydrocarbons - crude oil, natural gas, LPG and sulphur - which it supplies to state-owned entities and to midstream and downstream companies.
